name: watercolor

styleBlock.medium: Traditional watercolor painting on cold-press paper; transparent washes layered wet-in-wet and wet-on-dry, hand-painted illustration feel.
styleBlock.lines: Few or no outlines; forms are defined where washes meet. Soft, bleeding edges in wet areas, occasional crisp dried edges and tide lines; optional sparse, broken pencil linework.

palette.role: soft cerulean wash, sky and water

styleBlock.light: Light comes from the paper itself: highlights are left unpainted; gentle, diffuse illumination with no hard light sources; glow suggested by lifted or blotted pigment.
styleBlock.texture: Visible cold-press paper grain, pigment granulation in darker washes, blooms and backruns, uneven pigment pooling along wash edges.
styleBlock.contrast: Low-to-medium contrast; values built up in transparent layers, darkest darks used sparingly.
styleBlock.shading: Shadows as translucent glazes of cool color over dry washes; soft graded transitions and color shifts instead of black-based shading.

motionHints: light shimmering softly on the water
mist breathing slowly in the background
steam rising in faint translucent wisps
